image_location_description: Mid-lower center, directly above both legs; red/brown belt wraps the waist with a small front buckle/pouch.

steps.title: Base plate (2x6)
steps.description: Join 1x white 2x4 plate + 1x white 2x2 plate into a 2x6.

steps.title: Waist core bricks
steps.description: Stack 3x white 1x2 bricks on the base to make a solid 2x6 block.

steps.title: Top cap layer
steps.description: Cap with 1x white 1x4 plate + 1x white 1x2 plate, flush on top.

steps.title: Belt band front/back
steps.description: Add 1x dark red 1x4 tile front and 1x dark red 1x4 tile back.

steps.title: Belt wraps the sides
steps.description: Add 2x dark red 1x2 tiles (left/right) + 2x reddish brown 1x2 tiles as accents.

steps.title: Front buckle + pouch
steps.description: Center 1x flat silver 1x1 tile (buckle); add 1x RB 1x2 jumper + 1x RB 1x1 round tile.

steps.title: Belt rivets (main)
steps.description: Add 4x 1x1 round plates (RB) as belt studs on front/back.

steps.title: Side rivets
steps.description: Add 2x 1x1 round plates (DBG) as small side belt studs.
